named_question: What does the native cycling checkbox write, how is its displayed state inverted, and what does an omitted SkipNext mean?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Column4 writes the logical negation of the selected record's SkipNext at +0x8c.
Renderer stores SkipNext==0 into the column4 checkbox's checked member at cell+0x50.
Scene constructor zeroes the eight bytes containing SkipNext and Sequencing.
Common boolean reader compares its cleared/read temporary string against the TRUE literal and stores equality.
NUL-terminated TRUE comparison literal; comparison is case-insensitive.
Row column0 data supplies the exact record and its selected SID.
Post-click editor refresh supplies the selected SID to the first-match collection lookup.

source_contract.selected_field: Grid click column4 toggles only the row-bound mood's +0x8c, bound as boolean SkipNext. Column5 MixMod and column6 role membership are different operations.
source_contract.display: The cycling checkbox displays the inverse: checked means SkipNext=false. Report both the requested stored skip value and checkbox_checked=!skip.
source_contract.missing: The constructor initializes SkipNext=false. The binding uses common boolean type0 with param7=0; the reader clears its temporary string, reads an attribute if present and compares case-insensitively with TRUE. Missing input therefore stores false, not an unknown or inherited value.
source_contract.eligibility: Column4 is still a checkbox for special/non-MixMod rows. SID>31 and CID12..19 restrictions at this source site apply to other cells, not SkipNext. No unsupported graph/role predicate is imported from MixMod.
source_contract.refresh: The click stores the selected SID then refreshes the grid/editor. Since the refresh lookup takes the first equal numeric SID, reject ambiguous selected numeric identity rather than claim equivalent reselection.
source_contract.incidental_effects: Do not reproduce refresh-triggered Q1/HCL or complete accepted-dialog normalization.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-skip FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME (--skip | --no-skip) [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.selection: Exactly LightController2, one direct collection and one unambiguous direct mood matching exact stored SID spelling or case-sensitive Name. Selected SID must be positive signed32; all direct sibling SIDs must be supported signed32 decimals and the selected numeric SID unique. Nested decoys do not participate.
CLI_policy.values: Absent SkipNext has effective/default false. Explicit input is conservatively limited to canonical true/false; numeric, opaque and other spellings are rejected without defaulting or normalization.
CLI_policy.desired_state: Idempotent requested-state wrapper around zero or one native toggles. A false request on absent SkipNext preserves its omission. Other no-ops preserve original bytes.
CLI_policy.preservation: Write only the chosen SkipNext when its effective value changes. Retain all other flags/records, identity spellings/order/count/width, every Qn, SName, capabilities, LSConfig, HCL, sequences and unknown storage. Unneeded CID/flags are not parsed. Existing writer formatting and Document stamps retain normal behavior.

validation_scope.assumptions: Normal returns, successful allocations and valid non-null scene/grid objects. This is a selected-field transaction, not complete GUI permissions, import reconciliation, physical cycling behavior or a heap-purity proof.
